_comment: THE definition of the QCar model zoo: every HEAL fusion method trained on the same QCar data with the same training recipe. Read by qcar/zoo.py -- it hardcodes none of this. Relative paths resolve against the HEAL repo root. SENSORS: each method declares a 'sensor'; its generated config = bases[sensor] (QCar data, heter, pre/postprocess, loss, optimizer, schedule) + the 'model' section of model_from. Only 'camera' exists today (the QCar has no 3D LiDAR recording yet); adding LiDAR = add a bases.lidar yaml (heter modality with sensor_type lidar, e.g. pointpillar) and methods with sensor 'lidar' -- zoo.py needs no change. For sensor 'camera' the encoder's data_aug_conf and depth_supervision are taken from the base (1 front camera, 480x640, no depth GT). init 'full' = load the whole model from pretrained (architecture must match exactly); init 'encoder' = transplant only the tensors under encoder_init_prefixes from encoder_init_checkpoint[sensor]; fusion and heads start random. model_args: keys merged into model.args. set: dotted hypes keys applied last (e.g. model.args.cobevt.agent_size). keys_from_source: dotted keys copied from model_from too (feature_stride for methods that fuse at 1/4 resolution). loss_from_source: use model_from's loss. extra_plugins: appended to conf.json plugins for that method. source_text_fixes: literal {old: new} replacements on model_from's text before parsing, for upstream yaml typos (opencood/ is never edited). train_flags: extra qcar/train.py flags for that method (e.g. --no_amp).

max._note: F-Cooper (max fusion). HEAL's released opv2v 'fcooper' camera checkpoint was trained with fusion_method att (identical architecture to attfuse); max fusion has no parameters, so those weights load exactly.

disconet._note: HEAL's fusion_in_one.DiscoFusion imports disco_fuse.py, which this checkout lacks; qcar/patches/heal_disco_fuse.py restores it from the authors' snapshot next to the checkpoint.

v2vnet._note: Only deviation from the shared recipe: lr 1e-3 (HEAL's own v2vnet lr). With the shared lr 1e-4 it collapsed to all-negative (loss stuck ~19, 0 predictions after 15 epochs; run kept in checkpoints/qcar/zoo/v2vnet_failed_lr1e-4).

cobevt._note: agent_size sizes CoBEVT's relative-position bias (window_size^2 * agent_size); OPV2V uses 5 CAVs, QCar max_cav is 2.

where2comm._note: HEAL ships no camera yaml for where2comm; attfuse architecture with the fusion swapped (Where2commFusion takes the feature dim).

who2com._note: HEAL ships no camera yaml for who2com; attfuse architecture with the fusion swapped (Who2comFusion takes the feature dim).

coalign._note: Upstream camera_coalign.yaml has 'att:' missing above 'feat_dim' (invalid YAML); fixed in memory via source_text_fixes. Trains in fp32: its initial loss (~8e3) overflows fp16 under AMP (loss nan), finite in fp32.

pyramid._note: Keeps HEAL's pyramid loss args (per-level occupancy), but the detection head uses the same balanced BCE as att (qcar/losses/point_pillar_pyramid_balanced_bce_loss.py): HEAL's focal cls loss collapsed to all-negative on QCar.
